notices: HYPOTHETICAL DECISION SIMULATION: exploratory resource-allocation scenarios computed from an unvalidated point forecast with HYPOTHETICAL operational parameters. Not a validated staffing, budget or service-capacity recommendation for any NYC agency.

ARCHIVED PROJECTION: issued from the frozen snapshot, whose last observed day is 2026-06-30, for the target days 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-30. It is not a live forecast, and it has never been scored: no outcome after 2026-06-30 is in the snapshot.
A scenario with feasibility relaxed_terminal_target has no plan that meets every HYPOTHETICAL constraint: its reported plan and required spends are DIAGNOSTIC values, never budget requests.

HYPOTHETICAL STRESS PATH: each day's marginal M3 quantile, taken day by day. It is not a joint scenario, not a quantile of total demand and carries no probability; the M3 intervals it comes from failed their calibration criteria.
The selected intervals FAILED the pre-registered calibration criteria on the historical evaluation period: these intervals and probabilities are not decision-grade.
